text:
mira: Heads up — we need a plan for including explicit 'change origin' metadata in audit exports + console. Routing policy changes can come from the Console UI, the public API, and the rollout engine. Customers are asking 'who/what/why' in exports and the per-route timeline.

aj: Agree. what's the minimally required set of fields we should add to each change event? actor, ip, mechanism?

jen: Minimal I'd vote for: actor_display, actor_id, origin (console|api|rollout), timestamp, resource_path, diff_summary. Optional but useful: rollout_id, was_canary (bool), justification_text.

sam: big caveat on justification_text — it can contain PII or sensitive notes. We need redaction modes and an export-only sampling policy. Also export quotas to stop tenants from running full-history dumps every hour.

lia: For the console UX: show a small badge "via rollout" or "via API" inline on the change card, with an expandable link that opens the rollout details (if rollout_id present). For exports: include rollout_id so customers can cross-ref with their rollout logs.

dave: Telemetry side: emit a stable metric/event: audit.change.created with tags: origin, rollout_tier (canary|stable), actor_role, export_included (true|false). Also include a sampling bit when we decide not to include full justification_text in telemetry.

mira: Proposal: an NDJSON line per event in exports with explicit keys. Example: 

```
{"actor_display":"jen","actor_id":"acct_123","origin":"rollout","rollout_id":"rl_456","was_canary":true,"resource":"/routing/policies/policy-17","timestamp":"2024-10-12T18:45:12Z","diff":"+routeX -routeY","justification":"slow rollout to 10% due to perf concerns"}
```

mira: Notes: justification field should be gated (include_context=true) and default exports should redact freeform text.

aj: For export quotas: propose default controls: max 1 full-export per tenant / 15min, max size 5GB per export, NDJSON chunking with resume token for larger jobs. Enterprise customers can get higher limits via reserved capacity.

jen: Also carve out legal/ediscovery flows: proof packages for legal hold should be preserved and exempt from normal throttles, but every access must be recorded (audit trail) and gated by entitlement checks.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config change deployed -> feature flag: audit-export-throttle = enabled in prod 

sam: UX filter idea: console filter by origin + rollout_id + was_canary. Also export flag include_context=(minimal|full) to control what justification_text gets included.

lia: UX note: keep list compact — show "who changed what" with a 1-line diff and an affordance to expand into full diff + presigned proof bundle. Avoid dumping justification_text inline unless user clicks to reveal.

dave: Telemetry naming: com.redwood.audit.change.v1 as the event name. Attributes: tenant_id, origin, rollout_id (nullable), actor_role, sampling_bit. Retain full telemetry for 90 days, indexed subset for 13 months.

mira: Action items: 1) schema + NDJSON example (I'll draft open PR); 2) export quota RFC (AJ); 3) PII/redaction modes + legal exception flow (Jen); 4) console badge + filter mock (Lia); 5) telemetry schema + retention (Dave).

aj: I'll own export quota RFC and the chunking/resume token API surface.

jen: I'll take redaction + legal hold exception. Will loop in @jordan-legal for retention/hold rules.

sam: small thing — we should include a deterministic actor fingerprint (no PII) to help dedupe cross-tenant rollouts without exposing emails.

lia: I'll throw together 2 mock screens (compact timeline + expanded proof) by EOW.

dave: Will draft telemetry spec and suggested metric names by mid-next-week.

mira: thanks all. I'll open a tracking thread in the RFC folder and link here. If anyone objects to fields above, speak now.

jen: :thumbsup:

aj: LGTM

sam: looks good

mira: tagging followups: we'll need infra quotas to add a "preserve-for-legal" exemption. Will add to the RFC.

lia: quick Q — do we want to surface origin in the search index so you can query "origin:rollout"? that might be handy for support.

dave: +1 but make origin an indexed string enum, not freeform.

mira: OK added to tasks. Thanks everyone.
